{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert customer_segment to lowercase for consistency
data['customer_segment'] = data['customer_segment'].str.lower()

# Convert revenue to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
revenue_numeric = pd.to_numeric(data['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any remaining non-numeric entries after conversion
non_numeric_count = revenue_numeric.isna().sum()
print(f'Number of non-numeric entries in revenue after coercion: {non_numeric_count}')

# Inspect the original revenue values that failed to convert
failed_entries = data['revenue'][revenue_numeric.isna()]
print(f'Unique problematic values: {failed_entries.unique()}')"}
